blind.description: A stylized hand axe or hatchet lying flat on the ground. It consists of an ergonomically curved light brown wooden handle with visible grain and a widened pommel, fitted with a dark iron or steel axe head that has a beveled silver cutting edge. All surfaces are clean, smooth, solid, and continuous, with no disconnected parts or mesh defects.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a side profile of a hatchet resting on the ground, with the curved wooden handle oriented vertically downward and the axe blade extending to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat on the ground, it is only a few inches high; its total length from the top of the head to the bottom of the handle is roughly 1.5 to 2 feet, about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
